data.title: Rio Ave vs Famalicao Prediction & Betting Tips
data.content:
For Famalicao, Ricardo Silva is unlikely to make wholesale changes given the circumstances. Stability in the lineup will be the priority even if there is chaos in the dugout. Koutsias keeps his place up front as the club’s top scorer with five league goals, and the rest of the side picks itself for now.

Famalicao: Ceravic; Pinheiro, Rofino, Van Breemen, Bondo; Pena, Szucs; Beeney, De Amorim, Sorriso; Koutsias

## Recent Form [...] Cezary Miszta remains out with a back injury
 Brandon Aguilera is still sidelined as he continues his recovery from a cruciate ligament problem
 Joao Tome is available again after missing the Taca de Portugal win over Louletano through suspension
 Jalen Blessa is fit and firing, having scored in three of his last four appearances across all competitions [...] Seabra has a settled shape forming after two wins and Tome’s return gives him more options across the back four. Blesa leads the line and is nailed on to start given the form he is in. Expect a compact, direct setup from the hosts as they look to get the front man involved early.

Rio Ave: Hugo; Tome, Ntoi, Mancha, Vrousai; Liavas, Patricio; Clemmensen, Sellouki, Bezerra; Blesa
